A '''Bolenian hill-spinner''' was a member of a group<ref name="Reunion">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref> originating in the [[Bolenia system/Legends|Bolenia system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27848315|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-12-11|time=7:59 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170916153037/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-43|quote=I wouldn't get your hopes up re alien homeworlds, beyond simple stuff like the Planetnamian species getting a Planetnamia on the map or things Dan and I can account for with a relatively quick reference.|archivefile=File:JasonFry-JCFAtlasHomeworlds.png}} [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated his intention to create [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] for numerous [[Species/Legends|species]] based on context implied from their names. Given this principle, this article makes a similar basic assumption for the Bolenian hill-spinner in relation to the [[Bolenia system/Legends|Bolenia system]].</ref> The hill-spinners were tall in stature.<ref name="Reunion" />
